name: Cal.com
description: Cal.com is an open, customizable scheduling platform where users share a booking link that automatically syncs calendars, detects time zones, and handles meeting logistics.
best_for: Positioned for individuals, businesses that take calls, and developers building scheduling into their own platforms, with named use cases in healthcare, B2B sales, and support.
features: Two-way calendar sync to prevent double-booking
Configurable availability with buffers and notice periods
Stripe payment collection for paid bookings

alternatives.name: Calendly
alternatives.description: A scheduling tool that connects to a user's calendar and lets them share a booking link for others to pick an open time slot.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a polished, no-setup-required booking tool

alternatives.name: Doodle
alternatives.description: A scheduling and coordination tool that finds a meeting time across a group's calendars via polls and booking pages.
alternatives.best_for: Coordinating a time across a group rather than one-on-one booking
